business_summary: Yunnan Water Investment Co., Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the development, design, construction, operation and maintenance of municipal water supply, wastewater treatment and solid waste treatment facilities in the China Mainland, Indonesia, Thailand, and Hong Kong. It operates through five segments: Wastewater Treatment Project Construction and Operation; Water Supply Project Construction and Operation; Construction and Sales of Equipment; Solid Waste Treatment Project Construction and Operation; and Others. The company provides customized and turnkey solutions for water supply; wastewater treatment and solid waste treatments; and system integration services of technologies. It is also involved in the construction and sale of environmental protection equipment; and investment in wastewater treatment and water supply. In addition, the company offers raw water supply, tap water supply, wastewater treatment, disposal and recycling of reclaimed water and urban solid waste, and project contracting services. The company was formerly known as Yunnan Water Industry Investment and Development Co., Ltd. Yunnan Water Investment Co., Limited was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Kunming, the People's Republic of China.
